targets.query:
from(bucket: "iot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gestures" and r._field == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["gesture"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: sum, createEmpty: true)

from(bucket: "iot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "metrics" and r._field == "lat_ms")
  |> group(columns: ["mode"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: median, createEmpty: false)
